name: VIKRAM SINGH
pullQuote: “When 3,000 students storm the campus gates for ZEAL, failure isn't an option. Logistics is the unseen iron spine of MAC, and this department turns chaos into clockwork execution.”
fullLetter: Running operations for MAC meant managing everything from stage acoustics, campus security clearances, and crowd control protocols to VIP escort pathways for celebrity CMOs.

The operational resilience I developed in this club remains my biggest professional unfair advantage. When things go sideways—as they always do in live productions—MAC teaches you to stay ice-cold, communicate clearly, and solve the bottleneck in seconds.
To the future logistics commanders: respect the venue, protect your crew, and never leave an operational detail to chance.
